svg.text: The File Explorer: loading the tree and changing it
file-explorer/ · use-files.ts · convex/files.ts — lazy-loaded folders, recursion, and live updates
A project is open in the IDE (Code tab)
the left pane of the Code tab's <Allotment> (from Chapter 8)
projectId arrives as a string → cast to Id<"projects">
useState: isOpen = true, collapseKey = 0, creating = null, selectedId = null
useFolderContents({ projectId, enabled: isOpen }) (no parentId = ROOT)
getOwnedProject → signed in + owns the project, else "Project not found"
sort → folders first, then files, each A→Z
FileExplorer re-renders with the root items
passes down: projectId, selectedId, onSelect = setSelectedId
no items → "No files yet. Hover the header to add one."
closed folder: useFolderContents({ enabled: false }) → "skip": nothing loaded
B · OPENING FOLDERS AND SELECTING FILES
onClick → setIsOpen(true) → that Tree re-renders → enabled: true
→ children arrive → <Tree level={level + 1} /> for each ← RECURSION
→ FileExplorer re-renders → every Tree gets the new selectedId
→ that row is highlighted (Chapter 10: open it in the editor)
C · CREATING A FILE OR FOLDER
Header button, or right-click a folder → New File…
→ <CreateInput type="file" level={…} /> appears in the tree
CreateInput: type a name, press Enter
value in its own useState; FileIcon updates as you type
Enter / click away → onSubmit(name) · Escape or empty → onCancel()
"files" changed → that folder's getFolderContents re-runs → new row appears
error → reportErrors → toast.error("A file named … already exists here")
Rename: right-click → Rename…, or Enter on a row
onFocus → selects the name before the extension ("page" in page.tsx)
Enter / click away → handleRename → renameFile({ id, newName })
Convex: assertNameIsFree (ignoring itself) → patch name → touchProject
handleDelete → clear the selection if it was this item → deleteFile({ id })
Convex deleteRecursive: folder → its children first (and theirs…),
→ the parent folder's list re-runs without it
setCollapseKey(k + 1) → every root <Tree key={id-collapseKey}> gets a NEW key
→ React throws the old Trees away and creates new ones
→ their isOpen starts as false → every folder is closed
